text.tspan: • one DNS name for the app; spreads load
• health checks, stops sending to bad targets
• HA across AZs · public front, private back
• managed: AWS patches and scales it
• extreme performance, TCP/UDP, static IP → NLB
• inspect all traffic with appliances → GWLB
• health check: protocol + port + path, 200 OK
